units.source_text: 古歌：“穷乡僻壤无莺啭，今日盼闻第一声。”

en.t: An old poem says: "In this remote and lonely place no warbler sings; today I long to hear its first song."
This is quoted in Annotations to The Tale of Genji.

units.source_text: 明石姬诗中言“盼听早莺声”，意思是要她所生的明石小女公子回她一信。

en.t: When the Akashi lady writes in her poem that she longs to hear the early warbler's voice, she means that she wants the young Akashi princess, her own daughter, to send her a reply.
The title of this chapter is based on that poem.
